tests: <sl-progress-bar> > when provided just a value parameter > should pass accessibility tests
<sl-progress-bar> > when provided a title, and value parameter > should pass accessibility tests
<sl-progress-bar> > when provided a title, and value parameter > uses the value parameter on the base, as aria-valuenow
<sl-progress-bar> > when provided a title, and value parameter > appends a % to the value, and uses it as the  the value parameter to determine the width on the "indicator" part
<sl-progress-bar> > when provided an indeterminate parameter > should pass accessibility tests
<sl-progress-bar> > when provided an indeterminate parameter > should append a progress-bar--indeterminate class to the "base" part.
<sl-progress-bar> > when provided a ariaLabel, and value parameter > should pass accessibility tests
<sl-progress-bar> > when provided a ariaLabelledBy, and value parameter > should pass accessibility tests
